title: Telegraph Improved Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Classic English Variety
description:
Grow your own delicious, long, and crisp 'Telegraph Improved' cucumbers!


KEY FEATURES
• Produces long (35-45cm), straight, smooth-skinned fruits
• Mild, crisp, and refreshing flavour with minimal seeds
• Improved disease resistance over original Victorian variety
• Ideal for greenhouse or sheltered outdoor cultivation
• Prolific and reliable heavy cropper


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Dark green
Season: Summer
Growth Habit: Trailing / Vining
Flavour: Mild, crisp, refreshing with minimal seeds
Time to Harvest: 65-75 days from seed (from transplanting, earlier)


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Rich, well-drained soil with high organic content (Loam, Sand)
Watering: Consistent moisture (1.5-2 inches per week), avoid waterlogging
Spacing: 36-48 inches (90-120 cm)
Height: 0 ft. 8 in. - 1 ft. 6 in. (20-45 cm) plant height, vines up to 8 ft (2.4m)
Spread: 3 ft. 0 in. - 8 ft. 0 in. (90-240 cm) vining spread
Hardiness: Half-hardy annual (frost-sensitive)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in rich, moisture-retentive soil in a sunny, sheltered spot or greenhouse.
• Provide sturdy vertical support (trellis) to manage vigorous vining habit and heavy fruit load.
• Water regularly at the base, maintaining consistent soil moisture to prevent bitterness and hollow cores.
• Feed weekly once fruits appear to ensure a heavy and continuous crop.
• Harvest frequently (every 2-3 days) when fruits are 12-20 inches long and firm to encourage further production.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
